assessment: Research on push-pull systems has often focused on controlled environments, leaving significant gaps in our understanding of how these systems function under real-world conditions. This important and solid study makes a substantial contribution by investigating the volatile emissions and behavioral effects of Desmodium in natural and semi-field contexts which offer insights of broad interest for sustainable agriculture and pest management. While the authors rightly acknowledge some remaining limitations, the revised manuscript now provides a well-supported and transparent assessment of the ecological role of Desmodium volatiles in push-pull systems.
